create_gemma_config: create a GemmaConfig instance with default model parameters for initializing a Gemma language model
configure_gemma_model: configure a Gemma model by setting vocab_size, hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and attention heads in GemmaConfig
initialize_gemma_from_config: initialize a GemmaModel from a GemmaConfig configuration object for inference or training
inspect_gemma_config: inspect a GemmaConfig instance to read model parameters like max_position_embeddings and rms_norm_eps
customize_gemma_attention: customize GemmaConfig by setting use_bidirectional_attention to enable full attention instead of causal masking
